text:
jordan: Hey team — Meridian (prospect) sent an RFI asking for network peering options, SLA targets (they asked for 99.95%), and our suggested POC timeline. Attaching their questions and my draft capability matrix. Need ops + security to confirm answers by EOD so I can send on Tue.

ara: Uploaded a first-pass capability matrix here: https://redwood.app/drive/meridian-capability-matrix.xlsx. Key rows I filled: VPC peering, PrivateLink/Private Endpoint, IP egress ranges, IP allowlist, SSO/SAML, KMS/HSM, SOC2/ISO, POC pricing.

kai: Quick technical notes:
- We support AWS VPC peering for Hosted customers via private endpoints for Dedicated and Private.
- Azure Private Link / Private Endpoint equivalent available for Dedicated.
- Hosted API (public) can be restricted via IP allowlist + TLS client certs for enterprise plans.
- Dedicated + Private can provide static egress IP ranges for firewall whitelisting.

miriam: Security answers:
- We are SOC 2 Type II certified; ISO27001 in progress (Q3 target).
- FedRAMP: not certified; recommend Private deployment for Fed workloads.
- KMS: customer-managed keys supported for Private; Dedicated supports KMS integration (bring-your-own-key via KMS).
- HSM: available for Private deployments only.
- Data residency: we can pin regions (EU/US) for Dedicated/Private.

ara: Proposed POC schedule (4 weeks):
1) Week 0: Network & credentials (VPC peering, IP allowlist, service accounts)
2) Week 1: Model onboarding + small smoke tests
3) Week 2: Throughput/load tests (we need reserved capacity ramp)
4) Week 3: Acceptance, evals & handoff
I called out a requirement: for Week 2 we should request 2x baseline throughput as temporary reserved capacity.

jordan: Meridian also asked about POC pricing + committed discount if they convert. My suggestion: offer 4-week POC credits (cover infra + 50% of tokens), and a conversion incentive: 20% off first 3 months of Dedicated if they sign a 6-mo commit. Need finance ok. Any compliance or SSO blockers @miriam ?

miriam: No compliance blockers on this path. One ask: provide them an example IP allowlist snippet they can share with their networking team. See below — update the ranges before sending.
```json
{"type":"allowlist","ips":["34.12.23.45/32","34.12.24.0/24"]}
```

kai: SLA/availability note to include in RFI response:
- Hosted API: 99.9% uptime SLA (standard)
- Dedicated (reserved capacity + peering): can offer 99.95% with warm-standby cross-region failover and config pinning.
- Latency SLOs depend on region and model family; we'll include measured percentiles from our catalog for their target models.

ara: I'll draft the written RFI responses and attach the matrix + sample network configs. Draft link: https://redwood.app/drive/meridian_rfi_answers_v1.docx — please comment inline.

jordan: I'll consolidate and send to Meridian Tue COB if no objections. Also scheduling a sync: @deploy-bot please set a 30m call with Meridian and solutions next Wed 10:00 PT.

deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled — Wed 10:00 PT. Link: https://meet.redwood.com/meridian-poc. :thumbsup:

kai: I'll add measured p95/p99 latency numbers for their top-2 model picks by EOD.

miriam: I'll attach SOC2 report stub and our KMS integration diagram to the RFI package.

ara: Thanks — once I get final numbers I'll finalize the spreadsheet and Jordan can send.
